_comment: Version + build manifest for the Cernity NDR SIEM content packs (B-U8). Each pack is versioned independently; deploy/siem/test_packs.py asserts every pack has a version matching its native descriptor (Splunk app.conf, Elastic manifest.yml). `evidence.base_url` is the analyst-facing evidence/object-store gateway a deployer sets and the single source of truth for all three platforms; the pcap/file drilldowns URL-encode the id onto it and emit no link for a null id. build.py renders it into the Elastic/OpenSearch URL drilldowns and into the Splunk `cernity_evidence_base` macro. `external_destinations` are the two drilldown targets that leave the SIEM for that gateway.

evidence._note: Placeholder. Deployer sets this to their evidence/object-store gateway; the .invalid TLD makes an unconfigured deploy fail loudly instead of silently linking somewhere real.
